usageNotes: Lists all ACME accounts registered on the Proxmox Datacenter Manager instance. Use this before creating or assigning an ACME account to a certificate order to confirm which named accounts are available. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/certificates path.
tips: The response only returns account names — fetch individual account details via the account-specific endpoint if you need contact email or directory URL.
A fresh PDM install returns an empty array until at least one ACME account is registered.
Account names follow the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* — useful to know when scripting lookups by name.
